\begin{example} \end{example}[Basic link-complement volumes] \group ideal-simplex-volume Source: thurston:page-0178, thurston:page-0179

Two regular ideal tetrahedra give the figure-eight knot complement volume $6\Lambda (\pi /3)=2.02988\ldots $. Two cones on regular quadrilaterals give the Whitehead link complement volume $8\Lambda (\pi /4)=3.66386\ldots $, and two regular ideal octahedra give the Borromean-rings complement volume $16\Lambda (\pi /4)=7.32772\ldots $. \end{example}
